rules: Every expected answer comes from running the saved SQL against tm.player_season_stats.
split tune = questions used while tuning prompts. split heldout = never used while tuning, scored once on frozen prompts.
not_enough_data questions: the saved SQL returns 0 (the stat, league or season is not in the data).

questions.question: How many goals did Christos Tzolis score in the Belgian Pro League in 2025/26?
questions.sql: SELECT name, season, goals AS value FROM tm.player_season_stats WHERE name='Christos Tzolis' AND season='2025/26'

questions.question: Who were the top 3 wingers in the Eredivisie in 2024/25 by goals per 90, minimum 900 minutes?
questions.sql: SELECT name, season, goals_p90 AS value FROM tm.player_season_stats WHERE league='NL1' AND season='2024/25' AND position_group='winger' AND minutes >= 900 ORDER BY goals_p90 DESC NULLS LAST, minutes DESC, name LIMIT 3

questions.question: Which 3 defenders aged 21 or under had the most minutes in Liga Portugal in 2025/26?
questions.sql: SELECT name, season, minutes AS value FROM tm.player_season_stats WHERE league='PO1' AND season='2025/26' AND position_group='defender' AND age<=21 AND minutes >= 900 ORDER BY minutes DESC NULLS LAST, minutes DESC, name LIMIT 3

questions.question: Who had the higher goals per 90 in the 2025/26 Turkish Super Lig, Victor Osimhen or Mauro Icardi?
questions.sql: SELECT name, season, goals_p90 AS value FROM tm.player_season_stats WHERE league='TR1' AND season='2025/26' AND name IN ('Victor Osimhen','Mauro Icardi') ORDER BY goals_p90 DESC

questions.question: According to the scouting notes, which Belgian Pro League attacker had the highest goals plus assists per 90 in 2025/26?
questions.sql: SELECT name, season, goal_contrib_p90 AS value FROM tm.player_season_stats WHERE league='BE1' AND season='2025/26' AND position_group IN ('winger','striker','attacking_mid') AND minutes >= 900 ORDER BY goal_contrib_p90 DESC NULLS LAST, minutes DESC, name LIMIT 1

questions.question: What was Christos Tzolis's xG per 90 in 2025/26?
questions.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='tm' AND table_name='player_season_stats' AND column_name IN ('xg','xg_p90','xa_p90')

questions.question: Who was the best striker in the Brazilian Serie A in 2024/25?
questions.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM tm.player_season_stats WHERE league IN ('BRA1')

questions.question: What was Ardon Jashari's market value at the end of 2024/25?
questions.sql: SELECT name, season, market_value_eur AS value FROM tm.player_season_stats WHERE name='Ardon Jashari' AND season='2024/25'

questions.question: Who were the top 3 central midfielders in the Scottish Premiership in 2025/26 by assists per 90, minimum 900 minutes?
questions.sql: SELECT name, season, assists_p90 AS value FROM tm.player_season_stats WHERE league='SC1' AND season='2025/26' AND position_group='central_mid' AND minutes >= 900 ORDER BY assists_p90 DESC NULLS LAST, minutes DESC, name LIMIT 3

questions.question: How many passes did Joey Veerman complete in 2025/26?
questions.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='tm' AND table_name='player_season_stats' AND column_name IN ('passes','passes_completed','pass_accuracy')

questions.question: How many minutes did Frederik Tingager play in the Danish Superliga in 2023/24?

questions.question: Name the top 3 strikers in the Greek Super League in 2024/25 by goals per 90, minimum 900 minutes.

questions.question: Which 3 goalkeepers played the most minutes in the Ukrainian Premier League in 2024/25?
questions.sql: SELECT name, season, minutes AS value FROM tm.player_season_stats WHERE league='UKR1' AND season='2024/25' AND position_group='goalkeeper' AND minutes >= 900 ORDER BY minutes DESC NULLS LAST, minutes DESC, name LIMIT 3

questions.question: Who provided more assists in the 2025/26 Eredivisie, Joey Veerman or Ivan Perišić?
questions.sql: SELECT name, season, assists AS value FROM tm.player_season_stats WHERE league='NL1' AND season='2025/26' AND name IN ('Joey Veerman','Ivan Perišić') ORDER BY assists DESC

questions.question: According to the scouting notes, which of the nine leagues had the oldest average player age in 2025/26?
questions.sql: SELECT league_name AS name, season, round(avg(age),1) AS value FROM tm.player_season_stats WHERE season='2025/26' GROUP BY league_name, season ORDER BY avg(age) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which 2 players aged 21 or under scored the most goals in the Russian Premier League in 2025/26?

questions.question: Who were the top 3 attacking midfielders aged 22 or under in the Eredivisie in 2025/26 by goals plus assists per 90, minimum 900 minutes?
questions.sql: SELECT name, season, goal_contrib_p90 AS value FROM tm.player_season_stats WHERE league='NL1' AND season='2025/26' AND position_group='attacking_mid' AND age<=22 AND minutes >= 900 ORDER BY goal_contrib_p90 DESC NULLS LAST, minutes DESC, name LIMIT 3
